name: The Full Moon
summary: The night a scratch becomes a werewolf.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: A Human infected by a werewolf's scratch turns into a [[werewolf]] the moment the next full moon rises. See [[human-to-werewolf]].

sections.heading: When it comes
sections.body: How often the full moon rises and how long it lasts are [TBC].
